stories.title: Campbell says Hutchinson injury won't prompt celly ban: 'We're not talking to 8-year-olds'
stories.summary: Although Aidan Hutchinson's knee injury is a "gut punch" to the Lions, Dan Campbell said he won't tell his players to change the way they celebrate.

stories.title: Cowboys discussing new role for DC Parker after loss to 49ers, Jones says
stories.summary: The Cowboys are discussing the possibility of changing Christian Parker's role and responsibilities as defensive coordinator, owner and general manager Jerry Jones said.

stories.title: No doubts from Dabo: 'Coach Swinney's gonna win another national championship'
stories.summary: Despite going through a self-described "rough patch" over the past two seasons, Clemson coach Dabo Swinney is resolute in his belief that he and the Tigers have a lot more wins ahead of them.

stories.title: Yankees' Bednar, Twins' Jeffers accept $23.15M qualifying offer to return
stories.summary: Yankees closer David Bednar and Twins catcher Ryan Jeffers accepted the qualifying offer, returning to their respective teams on a one-year deal worth $23.15M.

stories.title: Pitching-needy White Sox, May agree to 3-year, $52.5M contract
stories.summary: The White Sox and free agent starting pitcher Dustin May have agreed on a 3-year, $52.5M contract. The right-hander went 7-9 with a 4.70 ERA last season.
